notes:
Asking to brighten the picture no longer changes the volume.

'turn the brightness up' planned a 2x volume boost — the card even said 'Increase the volume (2x)'. A request about the picture, answered by doubling the sound. Same for 'turn the exposure up'.

It now grades the picture, and so do 'adjust the brightness down', 'crank the contrast up', 'dial the saturation down' and the rest of that word order, which previously reached nothing at all. 'turn the audio down' and 'turn the sound down' also work now — only 'turn the volume down' did before.
